caption_alt: Three panels of the window-resolved local analysis at the strong-coupling points. (a) The local force-to-observable susceptibility against the local finite-time Lyapunov exponent at E=8, theta=pi/2; the signal responds strongly to local stretching. (b) The local record spread against the same local exponent; the noise responds weakly because the within-window record saturates at the attractor scale. (c) Grouped box plots of the local Fisher proxy logarithm at all six drive and flux-phase points, comparing the flux-phase dependence of the per-window signal-to-noise budget.
